text_block_list.text:
With the Kokura Kinen just around the 
corner, Nice Nature had become 
disheartened after seeing Tokai Teio's 
dazzling brilliance.

To help Nice Nature refresh herself, the 
Trainer has her mingle with the locals at 
the Kokura shopping arcade.

Interacting with the people, Nice Nature 
successfully reset her mindset just as her 
Trainer had hoped.
